import polars as pl, json, math, gzip, io

VARS = ['yrb_available_surface_water','irrigation_water_demand_province_sum',
        'production_water_demand_province_sum','oa_water_demand_province_sum',
        'domestic_water_demand_province_sum','water_consumption_of_province_in_yrb_sum',
        'yrb_wsi','total_population']

t = pl.read_parquet\('data_parquet/time.parquet'\)
# 用 yrb_wsi 抽样: 读全表太重\(18M行x2列\), 只读 scenario 0 和 500
df = pl.read_parquet\('data_parquet/yrb_wsi.parquet', columns=['scenario_name','step','value']\)

# 全分辨率 一个 scenario 的 JSON 大小
sc0 = df.filter\(pl.col\('scenario_name'\)=='sc_0'\).sort\('step'\)
print\("sc_0 steps:", sc0.height\)
vals = sc0['value'].to_list\(\)
raw = json.dumps\([round\(v,3\) for v in vals]\)
gz = gzip.compress\(raw.encode\(\)\)
print\(f"单情景全分辨率: JSON {len\(raw\)/1024:.0f}KB, gzip {len\(gz\)/1024:.0f}KB"\)

# 逐年降采样 \(每个 step 对应 1/16 年; 按年取平均\)
df2 = df.with_columns\(\(pl.col\('step'\)//16\).alias\('year'\)\)
yearly = \(df2.filter\(pl.col\('scenario_name'\)=='sc_0'\)
             .group_by\('year'\).agg\(pl.col\('value'\).mean\(\)\).sort\('year'\)\)
print\("sc_0 yearly points:", yearly.height, "| year range:", yearly['year'].min\(\), "-", yearly['year'].max\(\)\)
yvals = yearly['value'].to_list\(\)
yraw = json.dumps\([round\(v,3\) for v in yvals]\)
ygz = gzip.compress\(yraw.encode\(\)\)
print\(f"单情景逐年: JSON {len\(yraw\)/1024:.1f}KB, gzip {len\(ygz\)/1024:.1f}KB"\)

# 全部 9450 情景 × 8 变量估算
n_sc = 9450; n_vars = len\(VARS\)
print\(f"\\n全分辨率: {n_sc*n_vars} 情景序列 × {sc0.height} 点"\)
print\(f"  JSON ≈ {len\(raw\)*n_sc*n_vars/1e6:.0f}MB, gzip ≈ {len\(gz\)*n_sc*n_vars/1e6:.0f}MB"\)
print\(f"逐年降采样: {n_sc*n_vars} 情景序列 × {yearly.height} 点"\)
print\(f"  JSON ≈ {len\(yraw\)*n_sc*n_vars/1e6:.0f}MB, gzip ≈ {len\(ygz\)*n_sc*n_vars/1e6:.0f}MB"\)

# Int16 量化方案: 值×100 存 int16 \(假设值域 ~±32000\)
qvals = [max\(-32768,min\(32767,int\(round\(v*100\)\)\)\) for v in yvals]
import struct
b = struct.pack\('<%dh'%len\(qvals\), *qvals\)
print\(f"\\nInt16 量化逐年: {len\(b\)*n_sc*n_vars/1e6:.0f}MB 二进制, gzip ≈ {len\(gzip.compress\(b\)\)*n_sc*n_vars/1e6:.0f}MB"\)

# 值域检查 \(量化是否溢出\)
print\(f"yrb_wsi 值域: {min\(vals\):.2f} ~ {max\(vals\):.2f}"\)
EOF)

import json, polars as pl

# 1. 验证时间序列抽样: yrb_wsi sc_1548 前 2 年 \(对应 steps 0-31\)
static = json.load\(open\('viz/public/static-data/series/yrb_wsi.json'\)\)
df = pl.read_parquet\('data_parquet/yrb_wsi.parquet'\).filter\(
    \(pl.col\('scenario_name'\)=='sc_1548'\) & \(pl.col\('step'\) < 32\)\)
means = df.group_by\(pl.col\('step'\)//16\).agg\(pl.col\('value'\).mean\(\)\).sort\('step'\).select\('value'\).to_series\(\).to_list\(\)
static_vals = static['sc_1548'][:2]
print\("历史段 \(sc_1548, 1981-1982\):"\)
print\("  parquet yearly mean:", [round\(float\(v\),3\) for v in means]\)
print\("  static json       :", static_vals\)
print\("  match:", [round\(float\(v\),3\) for v in means] == static_vals\)

# 2. 验证聚合: 全部情景在 2020 年 \(year idx 39\) 的 mean/std/min/max/p05/p95
#   模拟 filters={climate:[1,2]} \(parametersToFilters 的 Any 逻辑\)
sc = pl.read_parquet\('data_parquet/scenarios.parquet'\)
match = sc.filter\(pl.col\('Climate change scenario switch for water yield'\).is_in\([1,2]\)\)
names = match['scenario_name'].to_list\(\)
y2020 = df.filter\(pl.col\('scenario_name'\).is_in\(names\) & \(pl.col\('step'\)//16 == 39\)\)['value']
y2020 = y2020.sort\(\)
n = len\(y2020\)
mean = y2020.mean\(\); std = y2020.std\(ddof=1\) if n > 1 else 0
import statistics
p05 = y2020.quantile\(0.05\); p95 = y2020.quantile\(0.95\)
se = std/n**0.5 if n > 1 else 0
print\(f"\\n聚合验证 \(filters=climate[1,2], year 2020\): n={n}"\)
print\(f"  polars: mean={mean:.4f} std={std:.4f} min={y2020.min\(\):.4f} max={y2020.max\(\):.4f} p05={p05:.4f} p95={p95:.4f} ci=[{mean-1.96*se:.4f},{mean+1.96*se:.4f}]"\)

vals = sorted\(static[sc_name][39] for sc_name in names\)
def q\(sorted_v, q_\):
    pos = \(len\(sorted_v\)-1\)*q_
    lo, hi = int\(pos\), min\(len\(sorted_v\)-1, int\(pos\)+1\)
    frac = pos - lo
    return sorted_v[lo]*\(1-frac\)+sorted_v[hi]*frac if lo != hi else sorted_v[lo]
m = sum\(vals\)/len\(vals\)
s = \(sum\(\(v-m\)**2 for v in vals\)/\(len\(vals\)-1\)\)**0.5 if len\(vals\)>1 else 0
print\(f"  static: mean={m:.4f} std={s:.4f} min={min\(vals\):.4f} max={max\(vals\):.4f} p05={q\(vals,0.05\):.4f} p95={q\(vals,0.95\):.4f} ci=[{m-1.96*\(s/len\(vals\)**0.5\):.4f},{m+1.96*\(s/len\(vals\)**0.5\):.4f}]"\)

# 3. scenarios.json 与 resolveScenario 验证
scen = json.load\(open\('viz/public/static-data/scenarios.json'\)\)
print\(f"\\nscenarios.json rows: {len\(scen\)}"\)
base = {k: v for k, v in scen[0].items\(\) if k != 'scenario_name'}
m1 = [s for s in scen if all\(s[k] == v for k, v in base.items\(\)\)]
print\(f"  全参数匹配: {len\(m1\)} 个 \(应=1: baseline 无 SNWTP 1 条; 若有 SNWTP 2 条\)"\)
EOF)
